title: Canonical scalar-forgetting evaluation and scalar Kummer classes on both small sites
statement:
Let $(C,J)$ be an essentially small site, with objects in universe $u+1$ and arrows in $u$, a terminal object $t$, and sheafification and Grothendieck abelian sheaf categories in coefficient universe $u+1$. Let $A$ be a commutative ring in that coefficient universe. Use the constant sheaf and module sheaf categories of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and derived categories of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Write $G_A$ for terminal evaluation on $A$-module sheaves, $G_{ab}$ for terminal evaluation on abelian sheaves, and $U$ for exact scalar forgetting. Define the abelian evaluation map $e_{J,F}^q:H^q(J,F)\to H^q(RG_{ab}(F[0]))$ by applying the derived constant-integers/evaluation adjunction to the Ext class, taking degree-zero cohomology, evaluating at $1\in\mathbf Z$, and applying the canonical shift and bounded-below/unbounded identifications. This specified map is bijective. Define $j_{J,F}^q:H^q(RG_A(F[0]))\to H^q(J,UF)$ as cohomology of the canonical derived comparison obtained from $G_A\,\mathrm{forget}=U G_{ab}$, followed by the canonical single-object identification and $(e_{J,UF}^q)^{-1}$. This specified scalar-forgetting map is bijective; no flatness over $\mathbf Z$ or preservation of injectives by $U$ is assumed.

For any scheme $T$, use its small etale and pro-etale module categories and canonical exact comparison $C_T=\nu_T^*$ from [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. Define the module cohomology objects $H_e^q(F)=H^q(R\Gamma(T_{et},F[0]))$ and $H_p^q(G)=H^q(R\Gamma(T_{proet},G[0]))$ by terminal evaluation. Define $c_T^q:H_e^q(F)\to H_p^q(C_TF)$ from the derived-unit comparison of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-global-cohomology], followed by the canonical exact-functor single-object identification. For an integer $m$, a commutative $A$ with $mA=0$, and a unit $w$ of $T$ with $m$ invertible on $T$, let $L_T^e=\mu_{m,T}\otimes_{\mathbf Z/m}A_T$ be the existing root line of [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-sheaf]. Its ordinary scalar Kummer class is the class of [lem-pur-relative-kummer-strict-local-invariance], namely $H^1(z\mapsto1\otimes z)\delta_T(w)$ for the ordinary Kummer sequence [def-sc-kummer-sequence], [lem-amb-kummer-any-base]. Define its etale module class by $(j_e^1)^{-1}$ of that class. Define its pro-etale abelian class by the canonical abelian comparison pullback of [lem-cbc-abelian-etale-proetale-cohomology-comparison], followed by the canonical scalar-forgetting coefficient comparison; define its pro-etale module class by $(j_p^1)^{-1}$ of that abelian class. These definitions apply to arbitrary schemes.
